tier1.notes: Installs in a few seconds from the app, no card removal. Fixes receiver status over Bluetooth. Satellite count, message rates and hardware details were either missing or frozen at the moment you connected -- a receiver holding a good GPS fix could report zero satellites -- and they now update live again. Reading the receiver's full details over Bluetooth also failed on every phone and now works, on iPhone and Android alike. Includes everything from 0.24.62-0.24.66: third-party EFBs work on a shared WiFi network with nothing to configure, and power, temperature and calibration warnings are sent only when there is something to warn about. The settings-file rename from 0.24.65 lives in the system image and still needs a card write -- a receiver updated this way works perfectly and simply keeps the old filename until it is next written from a card.

tier2.notes: Write this to the card to get the complete release, including the settings-file rename that an over-the-air update cannot apply. Your settings are carried across the rename automatically on the first start; they do NOT survive a reflash, so you will run first-time setup again. Download the .img.xz to a computer and write it to the microSD card with BalenaEtcher -- not Raspberry Pi Imager, whose WiFi/hostname presets conflict with the receiver. Do not decompress the file first.
